titles.title: Mule's Skull with Turkey Feathers

description: The long, narrow form of a tan mule's skull sits against a white surface. Two black and brown striped turkey feathers with white tips poke out from behind the skull, one at the bottom right and the other at the top left.
title: Mule's Skull with Turkey Feathers
